name: US–China / Taiwan
summary: PLA activity near Taiwan eases from the 3 Nov peak; Taiwan counts 11 aircraft and 10 warships on 7 Nov
state: Taiwan's defence ministry recorded 11 PLA aircraft, 10 warships and three other Chinese government vessels in the 24 hours to 06:00 on 7 Nov, and 125 aircraft sightings since 1 Nov (Voice of Emirates, citing the ministry). That is down from 49 aircraft in the 24 hours to 3 Nov, which an analyst called a quiet exercise without a formal announcement (Taipei Times). Watch is kept while the large deployment persists.
for_you: Check FCDO travel advice for Taiwan if travelling. Cross-strait tension tends to weigh on technology supply chains.
rubric_hit: Large-scale PLA activity around Taiwan, no blockade = Watch

sources.title: Voice of Emirates — Taiwan detects intensive Chinese military activity in its vicinity
Taipei Times — Heightened Chinese activity detected

why: The world's two largest economies; a Taiwan crisis would halt most advanced chip supply and risk great-power war.
drivers: PLA exercises, tariffs and tech controls, diplomacy, Taiwan politics, South China Sea incidents.

rubric.alert: Blockade or 'quarantine' of Taiwan, military clash, or severed diplomatic channels.
rubric.watch: Large-scale PLA exercises around Taiwan, major new sanctions/controls, or a naval/air incident.
rubric.normal: Managed relations; dialogue channels open; routine PLA activity.
